processing_notes: Zero/null cells were masked as NoData; no zero values were treated as measurements.
Source data values were retained; no outlier clipping or artificial sharpening was applied.
Reprojected from source Mars simple-cylindrical CRS into USGS SIM 3464 MTM_clon77.5E Mars 2000 Sphere CRS.
Output remains 100 m; resampling does not add spatial detail.
Thermal inertia is a thermophysical property, not current surface temperature.
limitations: The raster covers only part of the USGS map boundary; uncovered cells are NoData.
This is a derived thermal-inertia mosaic from nighttime THEMIS observations, not a live thermal map.
Grid alignment to the original HiRISE D3 raster is not claimed because the original D3 GeoTIFF/transform was not supplied.
